metric.name: E_framework
metric.movement: NO FROZEN-METRIC MOVEMENT; source-generalization obligation moved materially

method_outcomes.B3: PROGRESS: proved exact posterior-pair identity Pi_2=log E_{nu otimes nu} R, posterior-random-interface MGF bound, exponential-tail corollary allowing rare large interfaces, and direct D_n-o(D_n) degree-loss consequence.
method_outcomes.B30: PROGRESS: constructed exact bounded-arity factor-table polymer gas, derived a conservative explicit KP table-smallness condition and interface pressure constant, and identified first/second local replica-mismatch coefficients computable from finite tables.
method_outcomes.B21: BOUNDARY_TIGHTENED: local perturbation/interface free-energy control is classical cluster-expansion/complete-analyticity/locality machinery; no novelty claim for these ingredients; inference synthesis novelty remains UNVERIFIED.

mathematical_state.random_interface_pressure: Pi_2 <= N_n rho_n + log E_{nu_n otimes nu_n} exp(c |I_n|)
mathematical_state.tail_sufficient_condition: If P{|I_n| >= a_n+m} <= C_0 exp(-gamma m), gamma>c, a_n=o(D_n), and N_n rho_n=o(D_n), then Pi_2=o(D_n).
mathematical_state.factor_table_kp_condition: With factor-intersection degree Delta_F and eta=max(eta_0,eta_1,eta_2), eta <= 1/[e(Delta_F+1)+e^2 Delta_F] is a crude sufficient KP condition.
mathematical_state.degree_loss: For fixed admissible transport tilt s_0, g_n=ceil(Pi_2/(2s_0)+omega_n)=o(D_n) gives noised LDA control through D_n-o(D_n).

prior_art_state: Cluster/polymer expansions, complete analyticity/local free-energy stability, Gibbs locality, Kato/Toda/QR/spectral flow, Dobrushin methods and Renyi/collision identities are prior art. The explicit certificate is a self-contained specialization/repackaging, not a novelty claim. Synthesis novelty UNVERIFIED.
later_negative_stress: Songtao Mao arXiv:2607.20318 remains mandatory and is excluded structurally by the pressure/reference condition, not by naming the rank distinguisher.

next_attack.B9: Put an explicit sparse random defect process on a transitive weak-Ising/orbit model and compute the posterior interface MGF exactly or sharply.
next_attack.B19: Turn the factor-table theorem into a local certificate returning Delta_F, eta values, local replica mismatches, KP margin, pressure constant and degree-loss bound after selecting a concrete model.
next_attack.B2: Construct bounded-arity high-temperature examples with small expected interface but no exponential interface moment to test whether expectation control can replace the MGF.
